thread:
maria: Drafting a short emergency escrow & rewrap checklist for Redwood Private KMS. Key asks: DEK TTLs, BYOK preflight, emergency escrow grant with MFA, and audit forwarding. Quick ideas?
aj: Keep it minimal: never store plaintext DEKs; each DEK row stores ciphertext, wrap_key_arn, encryption_context, key_version. Add dry-run GenerateDataKey during onboarding.
sam: BYOK pattern: customer CMK + role redwood-controlplane with kms:GenerateDataKey/kms:Encrypt/kms:DescribeKey. Recommend a grant for high-throughput flows.
kevin: Two-tier cache: dataplane in-memory 45s default, control-plane metadata 10m. On rotation emit tombstone via pub/sub to invalidate caches.
lina: Emergency escrow flow: customer pre-creates an "escrow" CMK with a grant allowing arn:aws:iam::CUST:role/redwood-escrow ReEncrypt/DescribeKey when session tag emergency=true and MFA present. Require CloudTrail alerts on use.
aj: Backoff on ThrottlingException with jitter; after N attempts escalate to escrow. Never write plaintext to disk during retries.
sam: Rewrap worker: reads rotation events, attempts GenerateDataKey with new CMK, swaps pointer atomically. On partial failure mark dek as rewrap_pending and retry. If >5% fail in window, pause rollouts and alert sec + customer.
kevin: Ops snippet for emergency rewrap: assume role -> aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://dek.enc --destination-key-id <escrow-arn> --source-encryption-context '{"project":"p"}' --destination-encryption-context '{"project":"p"}' -> update metadata -> verify decrypt.
lina: Runtime decrypt validation: require exact encryption_context match; reject mismatches with 403 and log. Small example: def validate_and_decrypt(kms_client, blob, ctx): resp = kms_client.decrypt(CiphertextBlob=blob, EncryptionContext=ctx); return resp['Plaintext']
kms-bot: created issue SEC-7401 and runbook stub.
maria: I'll convert this into a concise runbook + CI verifier. Scheduling 20m sync tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
